- **Families Matter, Family Development Centre.** 
Its free programming supports any family with a child aged 0-6.
 
The drop-in programs are for parents and children together, and no registration is required.
 Its page lists two hubs, 
Horizon Hub NE and Midnapore Hub SE
. I read the page snippet only, and it points to separate drop-in calendars that I didn't see, so I have no current day or time.
- **City of Calgary Recreation, Kinder Room Drop-in at Southland Leisure Centre.** 
The page describes playing with your child on indoor play structures, and adult supervision is required.
 The only date I could read was a March 6, 2026 listing, which has passed. That listing showed a 9:00–11:00 AM session, 
drop-in only
. No toddler age range is stated on that page. Treat it as an unconfirmed reference until you check the current schedule.
- **YW Calgary, Family Champions.** 
It offers play-based activities for caregivers and children aged 0-12.
 The snippet gives no time or price, and it isn't labelled as a drop-in. I'd treat it as a lead to ring about.

I left out Genesis Centre Active Toddlers and the Calgary Public Library storytimes. I only saw the Genesis program on a listings site, not the Genesis Centre's own page. The library's A-B-C: You and Me circle time is for ages 2–3, and I found no current times for it.
